messages.en: I like how you've styled that shirt. You look really smart.
Thanks! I just paired it with black trousers.

senses.en_definition: Dark; having little or no light.
Unclear or not yet understood or known.
Bleak or unpromising; marked by hardship or little hope.
Illegal, unauthorised or conducted in secret.

messages.en: I've just got back. It's really dark on the stairs. Can you turn on the outside light?
Hang on, I'll turn it on for you. Watch your step coming up—there are shoes on that step.

collocations.en: be happy to hear the news

senses.en_definition: (Archaic) Proud and bold; stirred to anger or strong emotion.

collocations.en: become fired up; fly into a rage (archaic)
the commander is roused to fury (archaic literary usage)

messages.en: I got the job! I'm so happy I could cry.
Oh wow, congrats! All that effort you put into going for the interview the other day paid off!
My cat's getting fatter. All it ever wants to do is eat!
Is it eating at the neighbour's place too?
